steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Order. Each day-one step depends on those before it. A step that depends on a later step is flagged.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 day-one step depends on a later step

findings.title: Day-one step depends on a later step
findings.fix: Move the step earlier or the dependency later

findings.title: Risk with no mitigation
findings.fix: Name a mitigation and its owner

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] day-one-steps.md:12  Day-one step depends on a later step.
       Fix: Move the step earlier or the dependency later.
[medium] risk-retention.md:19  Risk with no mitigation.
       Fix: Name a mitigation and its owner.
[low] owner-list.csv:26  Step with no owner.
       Fix: Assign an owner.
Not checked: The people's reaction.
pros: Checks a step with no owner, a day-one step that depends on a later step, and a risk with no mitigation.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-hrc-integration-plan skill on the records for this review.
